name: TOB User Reading Plan
description: One user's enrollment/progress in a TOB Reading Plan. Only ever read/written through truth_of_bible.api.reading_plan's whitelisted methods (ownership checked against frappe.session.user there, then written with ignore_permissions=True) — no role, including the enrolled user, has direct REST access to this doctype, same closure-of-REST pattern used by Bible Battle's doctypes. A user may have more than one row per plan over time (e.g. Abandoned then re-enrolled); at most one Active row per (user, plan) is enforced in code.

fields.label: Completed Days
fields.description: JSON list of completed day_number values, e.g. [1,2,3]. Read/written only by reading_plan.py.
